note: Cumulative reported fatalities/injuries and source-reported daily changes are not distinct events. Do not sum cumulative rows, derive civilian/combatant status from age/sex, or add these figures to UCDP. Health-attack deaths overlap casualty totals and are not additional deaths. Announcement/report dates need not be dates of death. Demographic breakdowns have their own coverage.
